title: Open Advice
subtitle: FOSS: What We Wish We Had Known When We Started
description:
Forty-two free software contributors share the advice they wish they had received when they started: how projects work, how to get involved, and what keeps communities healthy. Edited by Lydia Pintscher.

Credit: Open Advice, edited by Lydia Pintscher and the contributors listed in the book, open-advice.org. License: CC BY-SA 3.0.
